Ms. Nupur Dhamija - Deputy Government Advocate for the resp
 Order

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant (483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023).
2.

The applicant is in jail since 26.03.2025 in connection with Crime No. RCT No.8404 of 2024 registered at P.S. Arera Hills, District-Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 426, 465,
468 and 471 of the IPC.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that co-accused forged rent agreement dated 16.10.2018 in the name of complainant and thereafter used above forged rent agreement for obtaining the license from Food safety and Controller and Drug Administration and allegation against present applicant is that he signed the aforesaid rent agreement as witness.
4.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Deputy Government Advocate for the State submits that from report of handwriting expert, it is evident that rent agreement dated 16.10.2018 has not been prepared and signed by the complainant.
Thus, applicant has prepared a forged document.
Therefore, he be not released on bail.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
